explication: Winhance is a Windows 10/11 enhancement utility for managing apps, applying system optimizations and customizations, and preparing Windows installation media. The user works through the UI to select actions; settings are prepared for compatibility and localization, then applied through infrastructure services. Configuration import/export and review, software management, and advanced ISO and unattended-install tools are distinct capability branches. The README documents the product workflows; source excerpts confirm setting preparation, dependency handling, power queries, and OSCDIMG setup. Other internal links are omitted where implementation was not sampled.
